domains.name: Media Arts and The Work Environment

standards.text: The learner demonstrates understanding of media arts production processes, professional practices, ethical standards, and industry engagement through apprenticeship experiences in media arts within creative industry settings.

The learner demonstrates proficiency and professionalism in media arts production through apprenticeship activities and portfolio documentation, reflecting artistic, cultural, and ethical practices within the media arts industry. 1

competencies.text: discuss media arts from the perspective of industry function and professional processes;
articulate the professional roles and ethical practices of media artists in creative industry settings;
evaluate the roles, responsibilities, and accountability of apprentices in media arts organizations;
demonstrate proficiency and professionalism in media arts tasks and workplace practices during apprenticeship; and
synthesize apprenticeship experiences through creative documentation.
